verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs list audit logging as a security feature (gitea-docs-28). The about page lists "Audit Logs" next to SAML SSO and autoscaling runners, which suggests a premium or enterprise tier rather than the free core (gitea-docs-31, gitea-docs-35). These are bare one-line mentions, so the scope and the review experience are unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of which user and administrative actions are recorded, a described UI or API for reviewing and filtering the log, clarity on which edition includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
